what_this_is: One Workshop search owner over every account list and file, with narrow scoped-list and HTTP adapters and index builders. Semantic rankers live under meaning; the engine supplies storage only.

payload.label: Search everything I keep
payload.job: Find anything in my account with one question across every list and file, by what was said, seen, named or written
payload.description: One question over every record and file name the caller hands in, and each installed semantic index among them. The caller reads the person's records and files from the person's own store and gives them as `records` and `files`; this run searches them and reads no store, and changes nothing. Results are fused by rank, never by scores across models, with addresses (the person's own record by id and kind, or a file by path), places (said, seen, name, written), timed moments and their original evidence scores. Semantic-index-descriptor records are discovered automatically; no index choice is needed. places and sources narrow the requested search. unavailable names every source or model that could not answer (a source not handed in too); pending names work still in progress. A missing model leaves literal words usable. A model with an encoder in the settings (a picture model) is asked with the query vector handed in as query_vectors; without one this row runs that encoder (the one other tool it may run).

question.description: The person's question or the words to find

limit.description: The most results (60 when left out)

index_ids.description: Optionally restrict file-content search to these installed indexes; discovery is automatic when omitted.

query_vectors.description: Encoded queries the caller made with a model. Each vector is used only for indexes with the exact same model identity and is checked against the size of the encoder in read-data/settings.json. Without one, a model with an encoder there is asked through that encoder when the run may run it, and is otherwise unavailable with needs naming the encoder tool and its input; other models embed the question themselves.

records.description: The person's records the caller read from its own store, as {id, type, value}: the kinds the search covers. Kind semantic-index-descriptor rows are the installed indexes, and their vector set files are handed in under `files`. What is not given is not there.

files.description: The person's files the search reads, by path (under /): each name maps to its text, or to {base64}, as the caller read it from its own store. What is not given is not there.

payload.label: Search everything I keep with one question (runs in a small container)
payload.job: Search every list, record and file name I keep with one question, in one ranked list, without my own computer
payload.description: Searches the records and file names the caller hands in (`records` and `files`, read by the caller from the person's own store) with one question, as a Workshop run: every kind of record (each kind ranked as its own lane) and the file names, merged by reciprocal rank into one list, best first. Each result has found_in (written for a record's text, name for a file's name), said (the text it was found in), score and address (the person's own record by id and kind, or a file by path). The run reads no store and changes nothing. unavailable names a lane that was not handed its input and why; pending names one still working.

payload.label: Search one of my lists with one question
payload.job: Find the rows of one of my lists that hold the words I ask, best match first, however far down the list they are
payload.description: Searches the records of one kind (one list) the caller hands in as `records` (read from the person's own store, that kind only) with one question: the rows holding every asked word, best first, each with said (the text it was found in), score and address (the person's own record, by id and kind). The whole list handed in is searched in one call, never one page at a time. This run is given that one kind only; to search every list and the files together, use tool:search-everything-with-one-question. The run reads no store and changes nothing.

records.description: The records of the kind the request names, as the caller read them from the person's own store: {id, type, value}. What is not given is not there.
